The literal positive independently walks parameter and capability TLVs from the configured OPEN, requiring exactly one literal code 1, length 4 and exact AFI/reserved/SAFI payload for each exercised application (1/133, 1/134, 16388/71), then requires application and unicast negotiation against a separately handwritten code-1 peer stream. Existing recorded breaks target Multiprotocol.WriteTo emitting 250 and parseCapability recognizing 250; the latter must fail for acceptance of the bad application, not solely loss of the unicast control. This independent current-source judgment credits only the capability-advertisement obligation.
